sourceReferences.supports: In Russian modal dative-with-infinitive constructions, the dative can express the implicit subject or participant to whom the modality applies. Nonverbal modal predicates such as надо, можно, and нельзя occur with infinitives; without an overt dative the modal interpretation may be general.
